sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: A minor in South Asian Studies may be achieved by meeting these requirements: Complete at least five courses for the required minimum of 18 credits. Students normally take courses in South Asian Studies bearing subject heading ASIAN or its cross-listings. Other courses with relevant South Asian content may also count, pending approval by the Department of Asian Studies. Typically, non-language courses are selected at the 2200-level or above. The following courses may also count towards the minor: two courses (of at least three credits each) in a South Asian language at the 1100-level or above and South Asian graduate courses. Language study is strongly encouraged; credits awarded for language cannot exceed six credits. Only one language jumpstart course may count towards the minor.
